lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately eight distinct vertical line segments are visible across the torso. Spacing is wider between the more posterior lines and more compressed toward the mid-torso and shoulder region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The lines located furthest toward the anterior (shoulder) and posterior (flank) terminate at approximately 50% of the torso's vertical height, whereas the central segments traverse nearly the entire visible torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two high-contrast circular white spots are visible on the lower haunch, positioned horizontally relative to each other.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrated silhouette, initiating with a lateral and posterior vector, curving medially at the mid-point, and finishing with an upward and slightly lateral trajectory at the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 1.5 times the width of the combined horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping accounts for approximately 12-15% of the total vertical horn length from base to tip.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white transverse chevron between the medial canthi of the eyes; white dorsal crest extending from the neck to the rump; white spots present on the long, dark hair of the ventral throat area.
